text: Write a program demonstrating the danger of a brace-less `if`. Fill in the two blanks so the output matches the comments.
choices: ___;                       // NOT part of the if, despite the indentation
explanation: Verified: with x = -1 the program prints only `always runs`. Indentation is invisible to the compiler; only the braces are load-bearing, and an `if` without them governs exactly one statement. This is not hypothetical — Apple's 2014 `goto fail` bug was a duplicated line under a brace-less `if`, and it disabled TLS certificate validation across every Apple product. Write the braces.
